name: BXH
rootCause: The decentralized transaction protocol BXH tweeted that the assets of the protocol on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC) chain were hacked.

descriptions.text: The decentralized transaction protocol BXH tweeted that the assets of the protocol on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC) chain were hacked.

BXH, a decentralized exchange on BNB Chain, was exploited on 30 October 2021 via a private key compromise, resulting in a reported loss of approximately $139 million. Control over the admin key allowed unauthorized access and withdrawal of funds from BXH's main vault. The incident resulted from a compromised administrator private key controlling the BXH vault on BNB Chain. The attacker obtained this key, possibly via malware or an inside job, enabling unrestricted fund movement.
